target_customer: Growing and globally distributed companies, first startups and later enterprises, whose People teams need an HR system of record
problem: Fast growing remote teams ran onboarding and people data across point tools or HR software built for SMEs or large corporations, creating manual work.
business_model: B2B SaaS per employee HRIS subscription with add on modules
product_category: HRIS and people operations software, now with an AI agent layer

founders.name: Giovanni Luperti
previous_startups: Product agency co-founded with Karolis Narkevicius, left April 2020
founders.background_notes: YC page: Director of Product Design at Qubit; TechCrunch 2021-03-02 says both founders were former Qubit employees.

founders.name: Karolis Narkevicius
previous_startups: Product agency co-founded with Giovanni Luperti
founders.background_notes: YC page lists a React, Node.js, Postgres and Kubernetes stack.

competitors.name: HiBob
competitors.what: HR platform for modern mid-size companies
competitors.funding_then: Series C of 130 million euros in 2021-10 per a Tech.eu tracker

technical_complexity.rationale: A modern HRIS with API, integrations to Google Workspace, Slack, Okta and Greenhouse, and workflows is standard SaaS engineering; the two founders built it as a small team.

defensibility.rationale: An HR system of record is sticky once employee data and integrations are in, but many vendors compete on features.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: Large HR and payroll platforms kept expanding through 2021 and 2022; Humaans stayed independent and added AI agents in 2025. Names from undated or later comparison pages, except HiBob dated 2021.

market_need_then: In March 2021 TechCrunch reported Humaans grew 3x in a few months with distributed company customers such as Pleo and ChartMogul, driven by remote work and hiring.

identity.logo: logo files offered in a public press kit
identity.voice_and_tone: Modern and product design led; founder is a product designer.

brand_strength.rationale: A playful play on humans but only a press kit and review pages were found; no independent coverage of the brand itself.

pivots.to: Athena, an agentic AI platform acting on people data
pivots.why: Company says it is now building a platform that acts on the data it records

outcome_analysis: Humaans joined YC in Winter 2021, raised a 5 million dollar seed in March 2021 and a 15 million dollar Series A in October 2022 led by Lachy Groom, reaching about 20 million raised. Remote work demand and the founders' design strength drove early growth. It remains independent with a team of 48 and moved into AI agents with Athena in November 2025 and US payroll later; no layoffs or acquisition found.
notes: Seed and Series A each confirmed by TechCrunch or Tech.eu and by the company announcement titles in search results; total of 20 million per Tech.eu and the company description. One aggregator names EQT Ventures and Anthemis as Series A backers, unverified and ignored. Founded 2020 per YC; another profile says 2019. Competitor HiBob source is 7 months after the batch. Valuation not disclosed. Complete coverage rests on 20 million stated total equals 5 plus 15.
